mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the UNRATE above 9.5% triggers labor market stress, raising long-term interest rates and dampening equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When demand (GDPC1) surges above supply (INDPRO) while INDPRO falls below its 12-month average, creating a supply-demand imbalance that drives investor uncertainty and negative returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when the supply-demand condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both demand indicators (HOUST and GDPC1) signal robust economic activity, prompting risk-on assets to surge and S&P 500 forward returns to be positive within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both increase in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both demand indicators rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 1.5% triggers higher interest rates, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during a tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month average predicts labor market expansion, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the supply index (INDPRO) below 90 triggers concerns about production capacity, reducing corporate earnings estimates and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO falls below 90.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% alongside a surge in demand (GDPC1), conflicting signals create market uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both signals occur.
